annotations.title: Get Media for Teams at an Event

description: Retrieve that season's media for every team at an event in one call: robot photos (imgur), reveal videos (YouTube), CAD (Onshape, GrabCAD), Chief Delphi threads, and avatars. Each record lists the team_keys it belongs to. Avatar records keep only their metadata; the embedded base64 image is removed to keep the payload small (use get_team_media for a single team's avatar). For media about the event itself see get_event_media.

event_key.description: TBA event key combining the season year and event code (e.g., '2023casj' for the 2023 Silicon Valley Regional, '2024txhou' for the 2024 Houston Championship, '2024micmp4' for a Michigan State Championship division). Use get_events or get_events_keys to discover valid event keys for a year.
